review.posthog_relevance: Adds Cloud-specific configuration and URL parsing support to CSP report-only middleware, enabling PostHog Cloud deployments to receive and parse Content Security Policy violation reports. This supports the operational mechanism of monitoring and potentially responding to browser-enforced security violations for Cloud customers.

This limits the ability to assess systemic risk reduction or broader architectural changes, keeping the score at tier 2 rather than tier 3.
